# Quellmoor Ridge O&M wiki

> Operations and maintenance of an onshore wind farm: OEM manuals and service bulletins, procedures and work instructions, incident and change records, maintenance, stock and SCADA data, laboratory and inspection reports, permits and grid instructions, training decks, correspondence, field notes and meeting records.

## Start here

- [Home](index.md): how to navigate this wiki
- [Agent guide](AGENTS.md): page types, citation rules, skills and tools
- [Glossary](glossary.md): acronyms and multilingual synonyms
- [Log](log.md): recent changes

## Topics

- [Blades, pitch bearings and main-component lifts](topics/blades-and-rotor.md): This page covers blade condition, pitch-bearing bolt re-torque, and crane lifts for blade replacement at Quellmoor Ridge Wind Farm.
- [Cold-climate operation and icing](topics/cold-climate-operation.md): This page covers cold-weather operation, icing controls, gearbox oil heating, and winter access safety at Quellmoor Ridge.
- [Environmental permit and night curtailment](topics/environmental-compliance.md): This page covers environmental permit conditions and turbine curtailment for Quellmoor Ridge Wind Farm.
- [Gearbox lubrication and oil changes](topics/gearbox-lubrication.md): This page covers gearbox lubricant requirements, oil-change procedures, level checks, maintenance tasks, and related condition findings.
- [Gearbox temperature, vibration and oil analysis](topics/gearbox-condition-monitoring.md): This page covers gearbox lubrication, temperature alarms, cooling performance, vibration trends, oil analysis, and bearing condition monitoring for the LT-32 fleet.
- [Generator brushes and electrical systems](topics/generator-and-electrical.md): This page covers generator brush maintenance, slip-ring work, generator temperatures, and electrical alarms for the wind farm turbines.
- [Grid connection and grid operator instructions](topics/grid-operations.md): This page covers the site grid connection, grid operator curtailment instructions, export limits, and related SCADA evidence.
- [Safety, isolation and work at height](topics/safety-and-access.md): This page covers safety controls for isolation, permits, access, working at height, rescue, lifting, dropped objects and related audit actions at Quellmoor Ridge Wind Farm.
- [Spare parts, stock levels and supply](topics/spare-parts-and-supply.md): This page covers spare-parts stock, purchase orders, expected deliveries, and work orders waiting for parts.
- [Training, site rules and acronyms](topics/training-and-onboarding.md): This page covers onboarding, site rules, working-at-height training, toolbox talks and site acronyms.

## Entities

- [A1001 Emergency stop activated](entities/alarm-code/a1001.md): A1001 Emergency stop activated is an alarm code in the reviewed registry. It was raised and cleared during maintenance on WTG-04 and WTG-11.
- [A2101 Gearbox oil sump temperature high](entities/alarm-code/a2101.md): A2101 is the gearbox oil sump temperature high alarm, with a warning threshold of 75 °C. Its trip counterpart is A2102 at 82 °C. In SCADA logs, WTG-07 and WTG-11 raised A2101 at around 75 °C.
- [A2102 Gearbox oil sump temperature trip](entities/alarm-code/a2102.md): A2102 Gearbox oil sump temperature trip is an alarm code for a gearbox oil sump temperature trip. It trips at 82 °C and stops the turbine automatically. The cooling circuit is inspected before restart, and the reset is not performed more than once without inspection.
- [A2110 Gearbox HSS bearing temperature high](entities/alarm-code/a2110.md): A2110 is an alarm code for Gearbox HSS bearing temperature high. It is raised at 90 °C. In the SCADA log, WTG-02 recorded A2110 twice, with values of 91.2 °C on 2026-07-19 and 90.6 °C on 2026-07-22.
- [A2120 Gearbox oil pressure low](entities/alarm-code/a2120.md): A2120 is an alarm code for gearbox oil pressure low. It is associated with a 0.8 bar alarm threshold. The alarm can occur after a cold start, and the listed causes include cold oil, pump fault, or a blocked filter.
- [A2130 Gearbox oil level low](entities/alarm-code/a2130.md): A2130 is an alarm code for gearbox oil level low. If the gearbox oil level is below MIN, the turbine should not be restarted and the issue should be reported to the O&M Supervisor.
- [A2140 Gearbox oil filter differential pressure high](entities/alarm-code/a2140.md): A2140 is the gearbox oil filter differential pressure high alarm. It is raised at 2.5 bar and can be caused by a clogged filter element or cold oil. The stated action is to replace filter element FGT-P-11872.
- [A3201 Generator winding temperature high](entities/alarm-code/a3201.md): A3201 Generator winding temperature high is an alarm code. In the WTG-12 SCADA alarm and status log, it was raised at 147.3 °C and cleared at 139.5 °C on 2026-08-26.
- [A3210 Generator brush wear limit reached](entities/alarm-code/a3210.md): A3210 is the alarm code for Generator brush wear limit reached. It appears when the remaining brush length reaches approximately 20 mm. Records for WTG-09 show the alarm was raised on 2026-07-16 and cleared on 2026-07-18, and the generator brushes were replaced under work order WO-26-0436.
- [A4105 Pitch system fault](entities/alarm-code/a4105.md): A4105 Pitch system fault is an alarm code in the reviewed registry. In SCADA alarm and status logs, it was recorded on WTG-12, WTG-05, WTG-06, and WTG-10 with S510 Stopped - fault events. The logged values were 1 axis, 2 axis, and 3 axis.
- [A5001 Yaw misalignment](entities/alarm-code/a5001.md): A5001 Yaw misalignment is an alarm code. It was raised and later cleared on WTG-11, WTG-02, WTG-06, and WTG-03 in the SCADA alarm and status log.
- [A6101 Grid voltage out of range](entities/alarm-code/a6101.md): A6101 Grid voltage out of range is an alarm code recorded for WTG-01 through WTG-12 in the SCADA alarm and status log. The log shows A6101 alarms and corresponding S510 Stopped - fault status entries, with clear entries also recorded.
- [A7001 Ice detected on rotor blades](entities/alarm-code/a7001.md): A7001 is an ice detection alarm for ice detected on rotor blades. It stops the turbine automatically when active. When ice is detected under A7001, there is no access within 300 m of a turbine.
- [Adventure Works Industrial Supply](entities/organisation/adventure-works-industrial-supply.md): Adventure Works Industrial Supply is a supplier with a typical lead time of 2 weeks.
- [AWI-10442](entities/part/awi-10442.md): AWI-10442 is a spare part associated with WTG-11. It is listed for a leaking hydraulic hose in the yaw brake circuit, and it is not stocked.
- [AWI-20915](entities/part/awi-20915.md): AWI-20915 is the identifier for a spare part associated with the spill kit of WTG-12. It was noted as needing a refill.
- [AWI-31007](entities/part/awi-31007.md): AWI-31007 is a spare part used as a tool tether set. It was used in work order WO-26-0203 for one unit under reference INC-2026-003.
- [AWI-40210](entities/part/awi-40210.md): AWI-40210 is an entity of type spare parts in the domain registry, mentioned in 1 source document.

Its Network Control issues curtailment instructions for planned network outages, including CPL-CI-2026-018. City Power & Light also announced July network works on the…

It is also identified as the customer or owner on several current Quellmoor Ridge Wind Farm documents, including maintenance, asset, stock, and safety records. The company is described as operating 12 LT-32 turbines at…
- [Fabrikam FGT-3200](entities/product/fgt-3200.md): The Fabrikam FGT-3200 is a three-stage gearbox used on Litware LT-32 turbines, with one planetary stage followed by two parallel helical stages. Its rated input torque is 2,410 kNm and its dry mass is 21.6 t. Only the lubricant listed in Table 4-2 is approved for the FGT-3200 gearbox, and…
- [Fabrikam Getriebetechnik GmbH](entities/organisation/fabrikam-getriebetechnik.md): Fabrikam Getriebetechnik GmbH is a supplier of FGT-3200 gearboxes. Its supplier lead time was listed as 10 weeks. Fabrikam confirmed delivery of two HSS bearings and offered air freight for an extra EUR 2,300.
- [FGT-P-11872](entities/part/fgt-p-11872.md): FGT-P-11872 is an oil filter element used in LT-32 gearbox maintenance. It is replaced during gearbox oil change and during conversion, and the filter housing cover screws are tightened to 85 Nm when it is replaced. The part is scheduled for replacement every 12 months, or at alarm A2140.
- [FGT-P-11880](entities/part/fgt-p-11880.md): FGT-P-11880 is a spare part used as a breather. It must be replaced every 12 months.
- [FGT-P-13010](entities/part/fgt-p-13010.md): FGT-P-13010 is an entity of type spare parts in the domain registry, mentioned in 2 source documents.
- [FGT-P-14002](entities/part/fgt-p-14002.md): FGT-P-14002 is an entity of type spare parts in the domain registry, mentioned in 2 source documents.
- [FGT-P-21904](entities/part/fgt-p-21904.md): FGT-P-21904 is an entity of type spare parts in the domain registry, mentioned in 2 source documents.
- [FGT-P-22328](entities/part/fgt-p-22328.md): FGT-P-22328 is a spare part: the generator-side HSS bearing for FGT-3200. It is a critical item below minimum stock, with 0 on hand and 2 on order under PO-76994. The bearing is needed for work orders WO-26-0412 on WTG-07 and WO-26-0439 on WTG-02, and WO-26-0187 on WTG-10 already used one unit.
- [FGT-P-22331](entities/part/fgt-p-22331.md): FGT-P-22331 is an entity of type spare parts in the domain registry, mentioned in 2 source documents.
- [gearbox](entities/component/gearbox.md): A gearbox is a component used in LT-32 turbines and in the Fabrikam FGT-3200 three-stage gearbox. The LT-32 gearbox has an overall ratio of 1:118.4, a rated input torque of 2,410 kNm, and a dry mass of 21.6 t. Its lubrication system uses splash and forced lubrication, and the total oil volume is…

- [generator](entities/component/generator.md): The generator is a wind turbine component used with a 690 V double-fed asynchronous generator system. It is driven at 1,500 rpm from the gearbox output shaft, with an overall gearbox ratio of 1:118.4 from a rotor speed of 12.7 rpm. Current records include generator brush inspections and…
- [generator brushes](entities/component/generator-brushes.md): Generator brushes are a component used in Litware LT-32 wind turbines at the Quellmoor Ridge wind farm. Work order WO-26-0436 replaced the generator brushes on WTG-09 under WI-GEN-014 after alarm A3210.
- [HSS bearing](entities/component/hss-bearing.md): The HSS bearing is a gearbox bearing on the generator side, identified in records as part FGT-P-22328. It is linked in the records to high temperature alarms, elevated vibration, wear, and spalling. The bearing is currently below minimum stock, with replacements on order and work orders waiting…

- [IMS bearing](entities/component/ims-bearing.md): IMS bearing is an entity of type components in the domain registry, mentioned in 2 source documents.
- [Litware LT-32](entities/product/lt-32.md): Litware LT-32 is a wind turbine product that uses a Fabrikam FGT-3200 three-stage gearbox with one planetary stage followed by two parallel helical stages. At Quellmoor Ridge Wind Farm, 12 Litware LT-32 CCV turbines are recorded, with turbine IDs WTG-01 to WTG-12. The LT-32 has listed…

At Quellmoor Ridge Wind Farm, its LT-32 turbines are recorded as WTG-01 to WTG-12 and are associated with Fabrikam FGT-3200 gearboxes. Its instructions and forms are…
- [LT-32 CCV](entities/product/lt-32-ccv.md): LT-32 CCV is a Litware turbine model used with Fabrikam FGT-3200 gearboxes on WTG-01 to WTG-12.
- [LWS-P-30418](entities/part/lws-p-30418.md): LWS-P-30418 is a 1.5 kW oil cooler fan motor spare part. It was replaced on WTG-07 under WO-26-0398, and the related oil cooler radiator was cleaned under WO-26-0399. Its minimum stock was raised from 1 to 2, and it is currently below minimum with 1 on hand and 2 on order.
- [LWS-P-30422](entities/part/lws-p-30422.md): LWS-P-30422 is a spare part referenced in the LT-32 Maintenance Manual gearbox alarm guidance. It is listed as a valve insert to check when alarm A2101 reports high gearbox oil sump temperature.
- [LWS-P-41120](entities/part/lws-p-41120.md): LWS-P-41120 is an entity of type spare parts in the domain registry, mentioned in 1 source document.
- [LWS-P-51207](entities/part/lws-p-51207.md): LWS-P-51207 is a spare part brush set that contains 18 brushes. It was used for generator brush replacement work on WTG-09 under WO-26-0436 and WI-GEN-014. A complete LWS-P-51207 set was replaced on WTG-09.
- [LWS-P-55031](entities/part/lws-p-55031.md): LWS-P-55031 is a slip-ring cleaning kit used for generator brush replacement. It is used to clean the slip ring before new brushes are installed and checked for free sliding.
- [LWS-P-60455](entities/part/lws-p-60455.md): LWS-P-60455 is an entity of type spare parts in the domain registry, mentioned in 1 source document.

- [MM-01 met mast](entities/asset/mm-01.md): MM-01 met mast is a 92 m meteorological mast at Quellmoor Ridge Wind Farm. It is located north of WTG-01 and is the reference for power curve tests.
- [oil cooler](entities/component/oil-cooler.md): An oil cooler is a component that cools oil, using an air/oil cooler with an electric fan and a thermostatic valve that sends oil through the cooler above 45 °C. At Quellmoor Ridge, preventive maintenance for the oil cooler includes radiator cleaning and fan current checks every 6 months. A recent…
- [oil cooler fan motor](entities/component/cooler-fan-motor.md): The oil cooler fan motor is a component identified by part number LWS-P-30418. It is a 1.5 kW critical spare part with stock below the minimum level. For WTG-07, the motor was replaced under WO-26-0398 and the oil cooler radiator was cleaned under WO-26-0399.
- [oil filter element](entities/component/oil-filter.md): The oil filter element is a component identified by part number FGT-P-11872. It is used in gearbox oil change and oil filter element replacement tasks, including the scheduled MP-GBX-02 task every 12 months. It is replaced during the LT-32 CCV turbine conversion and in response to gearbox oil…
- [pitch bearing](entities/component/pitch-bearing.md): Pitch bearing bolt re-torque applies to all variants of LT-32 turbines with M30 10.9 pitch bearing bolts. The task covers 100% of pitch bearing bolts and specifies a torque of 1,450 Nm in the cross pattern of the bolt map, blade by blade. On Quellmoor Ridge Wind Farm, the maintenance plan…
- [pitch bearing bolts](entities/component/pitch-bearing-bolts.md): Pitch bearing bolts are M30 10.9 bolts used on all variants of LT-32 turbines, with 72 bolts per blade bearing and 216 bolts per turbine. A current bulletin for them requires re-torquing 100% of the bolts to 1,450 Nm in the cross pattern of the bolt map, blade by blade.
- [planetary stage](entities/component/planetary-stage.md): A planetary stage is a gearbox stage with a planet carrier, three planet gears, a ring gear, and a sun pinion. The LT-32 uses a three-stage gearbox with one planetary stage followed by two parallel helical stages.
- [Proseware Lubricants](entities/organisation/proseware-lubricants.md): Proseware Lubricants supplies Proseware PWG 320 and Proseware PWG 220 gear oil. Proseware PWG 320 is an approved ISO VG 320 synthetic PAO gear oil, and Proseware PWG 220 is an ISO VG 220 gear oil used in the gearboxes of all 12 turbines.
- [Proseware PWG 220](entities/product/pwg-220.md): Proseware PWG 220 is an ISO VG 220 gearbox oil used in the gearboxes of Quellmoor Ridge wind turbines. It replaced Proseware PWG 320 in the turbine gearboxes under SB-LWS-2025-07 and MOC-2025-012. The oil-change procedure uses 60 L for flushing and 410 L for filling, and top-up is with PWG 220 only.
- [Proseware PWG 320](entities/product/pwg-320.md): Proseware PWG 320 is a gear oil with viscosity grade ISO VG 320 and synthetic PAO base oil. It was the approved gear oil for the LT-32 gearbox before the conversion to Proseware PWG 220. Current procedures state that PWG 320 must not be used for topping up and that residual PWG 320 must remain…
- [PWS-220-D208](entities/part/pws-220-d208.md): PWS-220-D208 is a spare part used to supply Proseware PWG 220 for gearbox oil changes. Each turbine requires 3 drums of PWS-220-D208 as part of a 470 L PWG 220 oil change. It is also listed in a completed gearbox oil conversion campaign from PWG 320 to PWG 220.
- [PWS-320-D208](entities/part/pws-320-d208.md): PWS-320-D208 is a spare part identified as Proseware PWG 320 gear oil in a 208 L drum. It is also specified as the new oil for gearbox oil changes, supplied as two drums per turbine for 410 L. The current stock entry shows 1 drum on hand, with 0 on order.
- [Quellmoor Ridge O&M building](entities/asset/om-building.md): The Quellmoor Ridge O&M building is the site office, workshop and stores at the site entrance. Its notes identify a bunded oil drum store. A monthly O&M review was held at the Quellmoor Ridge O&M building.
- [Quellmoor Ridge substation](entities/asset/quellmoor-ridge-substation.md): Quellmoor Ridge substation is a 33/132 kV substation with one 45 MVA transformer. It is located next to the O&M building and connects to City Power & Light and Skelvane 132 kV substation, circuit 2. The substation low-voltage boards are covered by the lockout/tagout procedure for work on the wind…
- [Quellmoor Ridge Wind Farm](entities/asset/quellmoor-ridge-wind-farm.md): Quellmoor Ridge Wind Farm is a wind farm with 12 wind turbines, WTG-01 to WTG-12, and a total capacity of 38.4 MW. It is operated by Contoso Renewables. The site includes a 33/132 kV substation and a Quellmoor Ridge O&M building.
- [rescue kit](entities/component/rescue-kit.md): A rescue kit is kept in every nacelle and has a sealed kit with a descent device. Its seal must be checked every day, and a broken seal means the kit must be inspected before the next climb. Rescue kit inspections are scheduled every 6 months under MP-HSE-01.
- [rotor blade](entities/component/rotor-blade.md): A rotor blade is a component used in the WTG-04 Blade B replacement job, which is described as a single blade lift. WO-26-0355 is a planned high-priority corrective-maintenance work order for WTG-04 to replace rotor blade B because of a trailing-edge crack.
- [S100 Running](entities/status-code/s100.md): S100 Running is a status code for WTG-07, which continues running with vibration above the alarm level. Yusuf requested weekly vibration reviews.
- [S200 Ready - low wind](entities/status-code/s200.md): S200 Ready - low wind is a status code used for WTG-01 through WTG-12. The status was recorded on 2026-04-10, 2026-07-24, and 2026-08-23. It started when wind speed was low and ended later at higher wind speeds.
- [S310 Maintenance mode](entities/status-code/s310.md): S310 is the status code for Maintenance mode. It is used in wind turbine lockout/tagout and SCADA status logs.
- [S420 Curtailed - environmental condition](entities/status-code/s420.md): S420 Curtailed - environmental condition is a status code used by WTG-03, WTG-04, and WTG-05. - [S600 Stopped - icing](entities/status-code/s600.md): S600 Stopped - icing is a status code used for WTG-12, WTG-09, WTG-03, and WTG-02 in SCADA alarm and status logs. In the cited log, icing alarms A7001 led to S600 status starts for those turbines, with later clears and S600 ends recorded.
- [SB-LWS-2025-07 Gearbox oil viscosity grade change for LT-32 CCV turbines](entities/bulletin/sb-lws-2025-07.md): SB-LWS-2025-07 is a service bulletin for LT-32 CCV turbines covering gearbox oil viscosity grade. It changes the gearbox oil from Proseware PWG 320 (ISO VG 320) to Proseware PWG 220 (ISO VG 220). The bulletin applies to all 12 CCV turbines at Quellmoor Ridge.
- [SB-LWS-2025-11 Pitch bearing bolt re-torque](entities/bulletin/sb-lws-2025-11.md): SB-LWS-2025-11 is service bulletin number SB-LWS-2025-11, revision A, titled Pitch bearing bolt re-torque. The maintenance plan for Quellmoor Ridge Wind Farm includes pitch bearing bolt re-torque task MP-PIT-01, covering 100% of bolts at 1,450 Nm every 12 months, and referencing SB-LWS-2025-11…

- [Skelvane District Environmental Authority](entities/organisation/skelvane-district-environmental-authority.md): The Skelvane District Environmental Authority is the issuer of Environmental Permit EP-2018-0417 for Quellmoor Ridge Wind Farm. The permit is signed for the Authority by Siobhan Carrick, Permitting Officer, and the Authority contact is the Permitting Officer for the Skelvane district.
- [slip ring](entities/component/slip-ring.md): A slip ring is a component that is cleaned with kit LWS-P-55031 and then fitted with new brushes that are checked for free sliding. Its cleaning task MP-GEN-02 is scheduled every 12 months and references WI-GEN-014.
- [SOP-GBX-010 Gearbox oil change](entities/procedure/sop-gbx-010.md): SOP-GBX-010 is a standard operating procedure for gearbox oil change. Revision B is effective from 2025-08-25 and supersedes Revision A. It is referenced by gearbox maintenance tasks, including the PWG 220 gearbox oil change task.
- [SOP-LOTO-001 Lockout/tagout of wind turbines](entities/procedure/sop-loto-001.md): SOP-LOTO-001 is the lockout/tagout procedure for wind turbines. It is Revision C and was effective on 2024-09-02. Isolation follows SOP-LOTO-001 and requires a personal padlock and name tag.
- [SOP-WAH-003 Working at height and rescue](entities/procedure/sop-wah-003.md): SOP-WAH-003 is the working at height and rescue procedure. It is Revision B and is effective 2026-04-07. All work at height must follow SOP-WAH-003.
- [SPL-012 Gearbox oil level check](entities/procedure/spl-012.md): SPL-012 is titled "Gearbox oil level check." It is used to check the oil level at the sight glass and top up only with PWG 220.
- [Tailspin Heavy Lift](entities/organisation/tailspin-heavy-lift.md): Tailspin Heavy Lift is an organisation involved in planning a crane lift for the WTG-04 blade replacement. Bram Okkerse of Tailspin Heavy Lift is the appointed person for this lift plan.

It applies to WTG-01 through WTG-12 with a 690 V double-fed asynchronous generator. Maintenance tasks MP-GEN-01 and MP-GEN-02 reference WI-GEN-014.
